paragraphs.text: Cave People is an obsolete two-word creature type for cards that represented a type of human who resides in caves .

Cave People debuted as a creature type in The Dark on Cave People . It was later re-printed in Fourth Edition , Renaissance , and Fifth Edition but has not been since. The type was later dropped in the Grand Creature Type Update , and it was given errata to just be Human .

The Cave People appear to be humans who resided in caves on the continent of Terisiare on Dominaria . In their original art, they appeared as an abstract humanoid peeking out from within a dark cave. In their reprinted art in Fifth Edition , they are much more human and are seen wearing clothes and having stairs and bridges connecting their numerous caves.
